job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Attend to technical workshops to identify technical requirements
Define application design and solutions including CI/CD and AWS services identification to be enabled with the support of the infrastructure architect
Support software developers using standard framework and applying standard design patterns
Coordinate technical actions and propose technical solutions
Assist the project manager in coordinating and testing technical actions carried out in project
Advice the project team on any questions related to technical choices
Build and improve common technical framework implementation and resources



Skill& Requirement:

Primary languages: Python (preferred), JavaScript/TypeScript, Shell,
Java Frameworks: for Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask); for FrontEnd (Angular, React, Node.js), REST API
Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DocumentDB)
Patterns: Microservices, RAG, AgenticAI Testing and software quality: SonarQube, testing tools (e.g., JUnit) DevOps practices: CI/CD, version control (Git), Docker, security awareness
Cloud skills: AWS Lambda development, S3 storage Experience with AWS (core services, deployment, IAM management, etc.) is a plus Infrastructure as Code: knowledge of Terraform is a plus
